root.label: Coroutine library
root.note: A non-owning handle, a no-op coroutine and two trivial awaiters; generators and tasks are built on top.

children.label: coroutine_handle
children.note: A copyable, non-owning pointer to a coroutine frame.

children.label: Typed and void
children.note:
Only coroutine_handle

has promise() and from_promise; any typed handle converts to the void form.

children.label: resume precondition
children.note: Suspended and not at the final suspend point; otherwise undefined behavior.

children.label: destroy precondition
children.note: Suspended at any point; destroying twice or while running is undefined behavior.

children.label: done
children.note: True only at the final suspend point; calling it on a destroyed frame is UB.

children.label: Trivial pieces
children.note: Library-provided building blocks with no behavior of their own.

children.label: noop_coroutine
children.note: resume and destroy do nothing and done() is always false.

children.label: noop equality
children.note: Handles from different noop_coroutine calls may or may not compare equal.

children.label: suspend_always, suspend_never
children.note: constexpr noexcept awaiters whose await_ready returns false or true.

children.label: Hand-written generator
children.note: Suspend initially and finally, store the value in the promise, own the handle.

children.label: Lazy start
children.note: initial_suspend returns suspend_always so nothing runs before the first next().

children.label: Final suspend
children.note: Suspending at the end keeps done() valid and lets the owner destroy the frame.

children.label: Move-only owner
children.note: The destructor calls destroy once; copying would destroy twice.

children.label: Hand-written task
children.note: A lazy single-result coroutine that resumes its awaiter when it finishes.

children.label: Continuation
children.note: await_suspend stores the awaiting handle in the child's promise.

children.label: Start by transfer
children.note: await_suspend returns the child's handle instead of calling resume.

children.label: Finish by transfer
children.note: The final awaiter returns the continuation, or noop_coroutine if none.

children.label: std::generator (C++23)
children.note: generator<Ref, V, Allocator> in <generator>: a coroutine that is also a range.

children.label: Reference type
children.note: generator<T> yields T&&; generator<const T&> yields references without copies.

children.label: elements_of
children.note: Nested generators transfer directly; other ranges need references convertible to the yielded type.

children.label: Move-only input view
children.note: Not copyable, forward, sized or common; begin() may be called only once.

children.label: Allocator
children.note: Pass allocator_arg and an allocator as the first two parameters to allocate the frame.

children.label: Range-for temporaries
children.note: C++23 extends temporaries in the loop initializer, not in an earlier declaration.
